images.caption: Langvatnet is a lake located in Fauske municipality in Nordland and is part of Sulitjelma watercourse. The former mining community of Sulitjalma is located at the lake's north side.

images.caption: Blåmannsisen is the fifth largest glacier on the Norwegian mainland. Breen is in municipalities Fauske and Sørfold just 2 km from the border with Sweden. Blåmannen summit is a nunatak on the glacier.
